Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

Do you have a passion for logistics? 

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.
• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.
• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.
• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.
• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.
• Fluent in English

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are looking for an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to strengthen our teams.Your role:As an Information Systems Security Manager, you protect the organization's information and digital assets against cyber threats by implementing the Safran Information Systems Security Policy.

• You will report to the Information Systems & Digital Transformation Director.
• You will implement the Safran Information Systems Security Policy within the subsidiary.
• As a member of the SAE and Safran ISSM community, you participate in its activities and act as the local representative at SAESB.
• You manage risks and compliance:
• You verify hardware and software compliance and monitor the execution of remediation plans.
• You drive regulatory compliance (GDPR, NIS2, Part-IS, etc.) and conduct cyber risk assessments.
• You coordinate responses to security incidents in collaboration with SAE and Safran.
• You test the Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP).
• You lead cybersecurity awareness and training programs to strengthen the company's cybersecurity culture.

Your profile:

• 3 to 5 years of experience as an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM/CISO) within a company of more than 100 employees.
• Experience in an industrial environment is an asset.
• Good technical knowledge of IT and cloud architectures and infrastructures.
• Knowledge of operational security and detection components (SOC, SIEM, EDR protection tools, etc.).
• Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO 27001), regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, EASA Part-IS), and risk analysis methodologies.
• Strong team spirit and ability to work collaboratively.
• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage stress and urgent situations.
• Organized, rigorous, autonomous, and accountable.
• Fluency in French and English, good Dutch.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior .NET Architect to lead the architecture, modernization, and technical governance of a portfolio of business-critical enterprise applications.

This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys shaping architecture strategy, mentoring development teams, and driving large-scale modernization initiatives using modern Microsoft technologies.
Key responsibilities

• Lead the architecture of multiple application domains and enterprise solutions

• Define target-state architecture and modernization roadmaps

• Guide development teams on architecture decisions and complex technical challenges

• Lead migrations from legacy .NET Framework applications to modern .NET platforms

• Drive cloud-native and containerization initiatives

• Architect scalable MicroServices and distributed systems solutions

• Provide architectural guidance for Blazor applications

• Mentor and coach Full Stack .NET development teams

• Facilitate architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical governance activities

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders

Nice to have

• Kubernetes (K8s)

• Cloud-Native Architecture

• Containerization Strategies

• Dapr

• NServiceBus

• Hangfire

• Distributed Systems Architecture

• Experience within Energy, Utilities, or Infrastructure sectors

What we're looking for

You are a strategic yet hands-on architect with a passion for building scalable, maintainable, and modern software solutions. You can influence technical direction, mentor engineering teams, and successfully drive modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.

📩 Interested? Feel free to reach out or share your updated CV for a confidential discussion.

• Minimum 4 years of experience as a .NET Architect

• Strong expertise in:

• 

• C#

• .NET (Modern .NET & Legacy .NET Framework)

• Blazor

• SQL Server

• MongoDB

• RabbitMQ

• strong knowledge of

• Clean Architecture

• Software Architecture Design

• Technical Leadership

• experience with

• MicroServices Architecture

• Enterprise Application Modernization

• Leading Development Teams

• Technical Governance

• Cross-Team Technical Delivery

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Professional English skills

• Dutch or French language proficiency

Accountant – The Role:
 

You will report to the Finance Manager and be part of a close-knit accounting team. Your role is varied and involves frequent interaction with colleagues from various departments.
 

Daily accounting: You will process payments from customers and suppliers and reconcile the entries with bank statements.
 

Invoicing and follow-up on outstanding invoices: You prepare sales invoices and send them to 
 customers; you follow up on outstanding receivables and take action in the event of 
 late payments.
 

Reporting: You collect data for the weekly profitability reports and the monthly KPI reports.
 

Reconciliations: You perform periodic (monthly and annual) reconciliations with customers and suppliers 
 

Invoice verification and collaboration with operations: You review and approve invoices from port, terminal, and administrative suppliers

 Accountant – About You:
 

- 
 You have at least a first experience as an in-house accountant, or in an accounting firm
 

- 
 You are fluent in Dutch & English
 

- 
 You have obtained a degree in Accounting, or in a relevant field
 

- 
 An experience in the logistics sector is definitely a plus, but not essential

Senior Accountant (m/v/x) - Shared Service Center (German-speaking) - Brussels

 

On behalf of our client, a leading international group in energy infrastructure, Robert Half is looking for a Senior Accountant for its newly established Shared Service Center in central Brussels.

 

 

Your role

• You are end-to-end responsible for a number of Belgian and German entities, from transactions and reconciliations through to closing.
• You handle the month-, quarter- and year-end closings: GL, payroll and tax accounting, and complex entries (BEGAAP / GEGAAP / IFRS).
• You calculate and book the IFRS adjustments, and carry out reconciliations and analytical reviews.
• You perform the intercompany reconciliations and follow up on differences.
• You do the periodic reporting (local GAAP and IFRS) to local teams, business controllers and Group Finance.
• You are the point of contact for auditors, tax authorities and Group functions.
• You help roll out SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud: process design, testing, documentation and training.
• You contribute to process improvement and standardisation, and act as back-up within the SSC.
 

Your profile

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting/finance. A recognised accountancy qualification is a plus.
• You have at least 4 years of experience in GL, closing and reporting, ideally in a multi-entity or international environment.
• You have hands-on knowledge of BEGAAP and/or GEGAAP and IFRS.
• You are proficient in SAP. Experience with S/4HANA or Public Cloud is a strong plus.
• You speak fluent English and good German. French or Dutch is a plus.
• You are autonomous, structured, service-minded and comfortable with change.

As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for the complete maintenance and repair of trucks within a professional team in Bruges. Your job covers everything from diagnosing technical issues to carrying out repairs, ensuring every vehicle leaves the workshop meeting the highest quality and safety standards.

On a typical day, you’ll analyze mechanical, electrical, and electronic problems, perform routine maintenance such as oil and filter changes, replace brakes, and renew components. You’ll independently manage each assigned vehicle from start to finish, carefully documenting the work performed. You’ll follow established timeframes, adhere to safety regulations, and work closely with your colleagues and the workshop supervisor.

Are you a team player with strong technical insight and a passion for trucks? Apply today and help shape tomorrow’s mobility!

• Technical diploma or relevant training in truck mechanics

• At least 3 years’ experience as a truck mechanic or diagnostic technician

• Category B driving license (C is a plus)

• Basic communication skills in English or French

• Willingness to be on-call occasionally (about once a month)

• Strong problem-solving skills and technical insight

• Team player with a proactive and reliable work attitude

• Strict adherence to safety regulations and use of PPE

• Open and honest communicator

• Motivated to grow in a professional workshop environment

Passionate about cloud-native platforms? Join a fast-growing software company and grow your expertise in Kubernetes and platform engineering

Our partner, a software company specialized in delivering tech softwares is looking for his/her next talent ✨

If you thrive in complex environments and love solving operational challenges through engineering, they'd love to meet you.

You will be working on responsibilities, ensuring the resilience, performance, and automation of our production platforms.
DevOps Engineer - Tasks & Responsibilities
• Design, operate, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based production platforms.
• Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, Ansible or similar).
• Enhance platform reliability, observability, monitoring, and incident response following SRE best practices.
• Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
• Collaborate with development teams to improve application performance, scalability, and operational excellence.
DevOps Engineer - The Match
• Proven experience as a DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, or SRE in cloud-native environments.
• Strong hands-on expertise with Kubernetes (mandatory), including cluster administration and troubleshooting.
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization, Linux, networking, and automation.
• Solid knowledge of observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, etc.) and DevOps tooling.
• Professional proficiency inEnglish and French(both written and spoken).

Is cybersecurity in your blood? Do you enjoy translating complex designs and business risks into clear, tailored security solutions? Are you experienced in positioning Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services and Security Technologies in complex, consultative sales cycles? Then this senior role could be the right next step for you. Within the Cegeka Security & Networking division, we help organizations improve their cyber resilience through end-to-end cybersecurity services covering assessment and advisory, protection, detection and response, and recovery. To support the continued growth of our global Security Solution Presales team, we are recruiting a Security Presales Architect based in Belgium. As part of the global team, you will support both Belgian and international customers, collaborating across countries with sales teams, security specialists and delivery experts on local and international opportunities.

 

• You discover and qualify customer security objectives, threat exposure, regulatory drivers, operational challenges and requirements, and translate them into a coherent security solution architecture and service proposition.
• You position and present Cegeka SOC, MDR and managed security services, clearly articulating customer outcomes, scope, operating model, service integration and value.
• You design security solutions across SIEM, XDR, endpoint, identity, cloud and threat detection, with Microsoft security technologies as an important part of the solution landscape.
• You lead the security presales workstream for complex opportunities, from initial discovery and workshops through solution design, presentations, demonstrations, proposal development, negotiation support and handover.
• You respond to RFI, RFP and tender requirements, including solution descriptions, assumptions, service scope, effort and cost inputs, risk identification and compliance mapping.
• You develop customer-specific business cases, transformation roadmaps and commercial solution options in cooperation with sales, service owners, product management and delivery teams.
• You coordinate contributions from SOC, Architects, Advisors and other subject-matter experts to create one integrated customer proposition.
• You ensure a structured handover of the agreed solution, scope, assumptions, dependencies and commitments to delivery and operational teams.
• You act as a senior subject-matter expert and trusted security advisor, taking ownership of keeping your security expertise up to date through strategic vendor engagement, relevant certifications and continuous awareness of evolving cyber threats and technologies.
• You identify market developments, customer needs and competitive insights, and translate these into actionable feedback for service owners and product management.
• You contribute to reusable proposal content, value propositions, sales enablement and solution templates, and drive continuous improvement through standardization, automation and AI-enabled pre-sales tools and templates.
What you need to succeed:
• At least 7 years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including substantial experience in senior solution presales, security architecture, security consulting or a comparable customer-facing role.
• Proven customer-facing presales experience is mandatory. You can independently lead discovery, shape solutions, create and defend proposals, present to executive and technical audiences, and guide opportunities through complex decision processes.
• Strong practical knowledge of SOC and Managed Detection & Response services, including the ability to discuss use cases, operating models, onboarding considerations, integrations, service scope and customer responsibilities.
• Strong experience with Microsoft security solutions, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, …
• Experience with relevant strategic security vendors and ecosystems. Knowledge of technologies from vendors such as Microsoft, CrowdStrike, Cisco, Fortinet and Vectra is valuable. Experience with additional SIEM, XDR, endpoint, identity, Network, cloud security and threat platforms is an advantage.
• Good understanding of cyber threats, detection and response, incident handling, threat intelligence, security operations and the business value of managed security services.
• Ability to translate customer requirements and risks into an integrated security solution, service scope, roadmap and commercial proposition aligned with Cegeka’s managed services portfolio.
• Demonstrable experience with RFI/RFP responses, statements of work, assumptions, sizing and pricing inputs, presentations and customer workshops.
• Strong consultative communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, structure complex information, coordinate virtual bid teams and take ownership of security pre-sales deliverables.
• You are based in Belgium and can work flexibly from Cegeka offices, from home and at customer locations. You are willing to travel when required.
• You will be part of Cegeka’s global Solution Presales organisation. Your primary market is Belgium, while you will also support international teams and global customers and collaborate with colleagues across countries.
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is required, preferably in an IT-related field, complemented by relevant professional experience and security expertise.
• Fluent professional English is required. Professional Dutch is required for the Belgian market, French is a plus.
• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft Security certifications or comparable security credentials are considered strong assets.

jobs.occupation: Line Leader Slicing - Meat Company | Oudenaarde | 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.
The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety.    

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
What is Cream all about ?

 

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues :)
Your future projects

Like Morgane, Business Analyst at Cream, you work close to business & IT teams and work on applications. Your tasks will be :

• Communicate with the different stakeholders in order to understand their requirements

• Translate business requirements into detailed business specifications for IT

• Analyze the impact due to required evolutions

• Perform impact analysis of new processes and determine the gaps between as-is and to-be situations

• Design and document the to-be process

• Organize the Test strategy and follow up the testing

• Coordinate and communicate with the different stakeholders

• Change management and deployment

• Adapt yourself to the new environment of our clients

What do we expect from our consultant ?

• You have at least 2 years of experience in Business or Process analysis

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high-quality deliverables

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• An experience in project management methodologies (Prince 2, PMI, Agile...) and tools (Balsamiq, Clarity, Jira, Azure, Enterprise Architect...) could be a real asset

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst MS Dynamics 365 (ERP) Finance & Operations
jobs.description:
Are you a Business Analyst with experience in MS Dynamics 365 (ERP) Finance & Operations? Do you see yourself as the bridge between business and IT, with a strong focus on both processes and people? Then keep reading, because you might be exactly the person we're looking for! As an ERP Business Analyst, you play a key role in understanding and translating business needs into effective solutions.

 

• You take the lead in identifying and defining business needs.
• You advise on which improvements create the greatest value by analysing business context, high-level requirements and ROI.
• You provide business cases to support Business Partners and Project Managers in defining roadmaps and initiating projects.
• Together with the Application Architect, you define high-level solutions that contribute maximally to business objectives.
• You document your analyses clearly and accurately, using appropriate business analysis techniques.
• You manage priorities and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders and technical teams.
• You work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects and external partners.
• You support business stakeholders in decision-making and provide insights to maximise ROI.
• You are responsible for monitoring and safeguarding the achievement of initial objectives throughout project delivery.
• You are able to prioritise business needs across multiple stakeholders and domains.
What you need to succeed:
• You hold a higher education degree (preferably a Master's degree) and have at least 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst.
• You enjoy acting as the bridge between business and IT.
• With strong analytical skills, you work in a structured, results-oriented manner.
• You are a team player, but you are equally comfortable working independently.
• You have a hands-on mindset and enjoy tackling complex challenges.
• You have experience with tools and systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Office tools), Confluence, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and Jira.
• Experience and knowledge within Procurement are a plus.
• You are familiar with Agile methodologies, ITIL processes and BPMN modelling.
• You communicate fluently in both Dutch and English.
• You work from our Hasselt (Corda Campus) office at least one day per week, combined with remote working.

Do you have a proven track record when it comes to succesfully realizing CRM implementations as a Project Manager? Do you ensure that your customers' projects are implemented within the agreed scope, budget and time? Do you also have functional skills? And are you looking for a new challenge? Then join our Customer Engagement team and work on innovative projects for our customers, using the various technologies in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 stack. Our team consists of 50 passionate and motivated colleagues, each with different areas of expertise. We are part of the Cegeka Business Solutions Belgium, which consists of +- 280 consultants. In addition to Microsoft Gold Partner status and the Inner Circle Label, we were named Western Europe Partner of the Year in the Business Applications Cloud category in 2023, and Microsoft Partner of The Year in Belgium in 2024. We therefore work very closely with Microsoft for knowledge sharing and growth. Would you like to help build our growth story?

 

• As Project Manager, you will be responsible for the implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement projects at our customers. This primarily involves delivering the entire project within the agreed scope, budget and time. 
• You monitor and report on all aspects of the project so that it meets organisational requirements, methodology and quality standards.
• You are the primary point of contact for the customer. You translate expectations into a project plan with clear objectives that are approved by the steering committee.
• You organise the project kick-off, ensuring that all employees and stakeholders are informed and aligned with the project plan.
• During the duration of the project, you motivate and guide the project team towards the objectives to be achieved. You do this through regular project evaluations and feedback interviews.
• You advise the customer throughout the implementation process and take the lead in internal and external project meetings.
• You identify and manage project risks, bottlenecks and changes.
• You constantly update the project plan, keeping it ‘up to date’. You consistently apply Cegeka's project methodology.
What you need to succeed:
• You have a proven track record as a Project Manager in achieving CRM implementations. Knowledge of Dynamics CRM/D365 Customer Engagement is a big plus.
• You have a good knowledge of the functional and technical specifications involved in CRM implementation projects.
• Through your expert knowledge, your flair, your flexibility and your commitment, you succeed in winning our customers' trust.
• To manage your team, you have excellent leadership and communication skills.
• You have an excellent knowledge of Dutch and English.
• Being certified in at least one project methodology such as Prince2 or PMBOK is a plus.
• You immediately feel at home in Cegeka's result-oriented, no-nonsense approach.

Are you looking for a full-time day-shift job in a production environment in the Tielt area? In this role, you’ll support the flow of goods involved in manufacturing windows and doors.

A metalworking production environment

You’ll join a workplace where metal windows and doors are made.

What you’ll do:

• 
Receive, inspect, and store goods and materials.

• 
Load windows and doors onto racks and gather materials for production.

• 
Move windows, doors, and components within the facility, and help with loading and unloading.

• 
Inspect finished products and prepare them for shipping.

• 
Keep the warehouse and work areas organized, track the flow of goods, and step in where needed.

Do you thrive when you can roll up your sleeves and work alongside colleagues to get things done? Then you may recognize yourself in this profile.

• 
You’re someone who sees what needs to be done and likes to pitch in.

• 
You’re comfortable with physical work, and it doesn’t hold you back from staying active.

• 
You approach your work with accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility.

• 
Your positive attitude helps you contribute to a great team environment.

• 
You have a good command of Dutch or English.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager & Business Analyst – Passenger Information Systems
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Define the global target vision for dynamic traveler information systems, including lifecycle and maintenance analysis.
• Perform economic evaluations using TCO and CAPEX/OPEX models to support multi-year investment roadmaps.
• Translate strategic objectives into business cases, decision files, and technical specifications for procurement.
• Lead the cloud migration of information systems by defining target architectures in collaboration with IT and security experts.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams including vendors, business stakeholders, and infrastructure departments.
• Manage testing, cut-over strategies, and post-migration stabilization to ensure service continuity.
• Establish operational frameworks, including SLAs, KPIs, and service management processes.

Requirements

• 8+ years in IT Project Management and Business Analysis within complex, large-scale environments.
• 5+ years in Asset & Lifecycle Management, including obsolescence analysis and Capacity Planning.
• 3+ years of experience leading Cloud Migration projects and Dependency Management.
• Experience with Application Integration and defining target architectures for hardware-software systems.
• Proven expertise in Budget Management and Supplier Relationship Management, including contract negotiations.
• Proficiency in drafting Business Cases and technical specifications for public tenders or formal procurement processes.
• Knowledge of ServiceNow for monitoring and service management.
• Proactive and solution-oriented with excellent executive reporting and stakeholder management skills.
• You are fluent in French and Dutch with professional proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications in Project Management (e.g., PRINCE2, PMP) or Agile methodologies.
• Professional experience within the public transport or mobility sector.
• Knowledge of Security, IAM, or GDPR requirements in a cloud context.
